headline: 198 hospitalised in 24 hours as dengue cases cross 5,500
summary: One more person has died, bringing the total death toll to 13, as the number of hospitalisations continues to rise across the country.
details: At least one dengue patient died and 198 others were hospitalised within a 24-hour window ending at 8:00 am today.
With these latest figures, the total number of dengue cases has risen to 5,515, while the total death toll has reached 13.
Currently, 435 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at various hospitals across Bangladesh.
Health authorities continue to monitor the situation as hospitalisations spike.
caption:
Dengue cases have crossed 5,500 in Bangladesh, with 198 people hospitalised in just one day.

At least one dengue patient died and 198 others were hospitalised within a 24-hour window ending at 8:00 am today.

With these latest figures, the total number of dengue cases has risen to 5,515, while the total death toll has reached 13.

Currently, 435 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at various hospitals across Bangladesh.

Health authorities continue to monitor the situation as hospitalisations spike.

headline_marked: Measles outbreak: [[698 children die]] as death toll rises
headline: Measles outbreak: 698 children die as death toll rises
summary: Nine more children died in 24 hours, bringing the total number of deaths from measles and measles-like symptoms since March 15 to 698.
details: Nine children died within 24 hours (from Wednesday 8 AM to Thursday 8 AM) due to measles symptoms, according to a report from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
Since March 15, a total of 605 children have died from measles symptoms and another 93 have died from confirmed measles, bringing the total death toll to 698.
In the last 24 hours alone, 945 children were infected with measles or measles-like symptoms.
DGHS data shows that since March 15, there have been 96,653 suspected cases of measles measles-like symptoms and 11,442 confirmed cases.
Out of the total suspected cases, 80,497 patients were admitted to hospitals, and 76,788 have already been discharged.
caption:
698 children have died since March 15 due to a measles outbreak in Bangladesh.

Nine children died within 24 hours (from Wednesday 8 AM to Thursday 8 AM) due to measles symptoms, according to a report from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).

Since March 15, a total of 605 children have died from measles symptoms and another 93 have died from confirmed measles, bringing the total death toll to 698.

In the last 24 hours alone, 945 children were infected with measles or measles-like symptoms.

DGHS data shows that since March 15, there have been 96,653 suspected cases of measles measles-like symptoms and 11,442 confirmed cases.

Out of the total suspected cases, 80,497 patients were admitted to hospitals, and 76,788 have already been discharged.

#Bangladesh #MeaslesOutbreak #HealthCrisis #DGHS #PublicHealth

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, Somoy News
